defects.title: Schedule browser invocation produced no report on native Linux
defects.reproduction: GitHub Actions run 41491331244, stock-peer-linux; collections and arrivals completed before qualify-schedules.py browser-create
defects.first_failure: FileNotFoundError: browser-create/onboarding-exchange-browser.json
defects.cause: Run 10's early launch probe reproduced the missing report: Ubuntu 24.04 AppArmor denies unprivileged namespaces to Playwright's downloaded Chromium shell, so Chromium reports no usable sandbox. The original run 9 wrapper log alone did not expose this cause.
defects.resolution: Run 10 preserved chromiumSandbox:true and established the launch failure. Commit 1ebf6d0 selects the runner-installed Chrome channel while retaining the sandbox and all schedule assertions. GitHub run 41496634777 launched Chrome 156.0.8078.47 with the sandbox and passed the original collection, arrival and schedule scripts.

defects.first_failure: gpg: can't open '/fixture/recipient-private.gpg': Permission denied

defects.title: Windows native unit suite exposed unsupported permission and durability behavior
defects.reproduction: GitHub Actions run 41496634781, windows-amd64, go test ./... on native Windows 2025
defects.first_failure: TestSetupPlanPreservesCredentialAndRefusesChangedReferences: setup reference parent must already be a private mode-0700 directory
observed_failures: Directory Sync returned Access is denied for crypto audit and SSH secret tests.
Custody tests could not establish a private mode-0700 root under Windows file-permission semantics.
The browser source byte hash differed for web/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt on Windows checkout; line-ending conversion is a hypothesis, not established cause.
Synthetic scanner clean/infected/limit/encrypted cases returned scanner unavailable or unverified.
defects.cause: Native Windows does not provide Unix private-directory/socket permission semantics through os.Chmod, and current directory Sync handles return Access is denied. Byte-preserving checkout repairs the browser source hash. Native job 125495209312 on b1ca6c1 reports is_socket=true and permission_bits=0666 after the fixture requests 0600, so the existing private-socket guard necessarily refuses that metadata; later scanner transport remains unqualified.
defects.resolution: Commits a82fec1/a7aae47 preserve committed bytes with .gitattributes; repeated native Windows runs pass internal/browser. Job 125495209312 narrows the scanner refusal to its private-socket metadata boundary (0666 despite requested 0600), without weakening the check. Private-directory ACL, protected socket access and directory durability remain red. Implement and independently test native Windows access-control and durable metadata behavior, then rerun the original unit/service journeys. Cross-builds cannot close this defect.

defects.title: Corrected routing fixture used the wrong workflow revision request field
defects.reproduction: GitHub run 41500650539, Stock peers (captured-routing), corrected-routing-draft
defects.first_failure: AssertionError: ('corrected-routing-draft', 400, 200)
defects.cause: The qualification fixture sent id while the strict DraftRequest JSON contract requires workflow_id. The API correctly refused the unknown field.
defects.resolution: Use workflow_id in the exact new revision request. GitHub run 41503113307 accepts the corrected revision draft and approval, then reaches the separate D105 browser response-observation failure. Seven summary privacy/refusal contracts and HTTP-status mismatch counting pass. Both complete selected routing scripts now pass on candidate cdbe5e2, including native corrected revision-2 stock delivery; this does not close full J03.

defects.title: Original routing browser phase failed on native Linux
defects.reproduction: GitHub run 41500650539, Stock peers (routing), native-browser-route
defects.first_failure: ValueError: browser failed or reported page errors/external egress: native-browser-route
defects.cause: Hash-checked safe diagnostics on run 41503113307 locate failures at routing-browser.mjs response().then(r.json), first during initial collection inspection in the corrected journey and later during a send-phase inspection in the original journey. Both have zero browser runtime errors and zero external contacts. A transient Chromium response-body observation issue is the leading inference; no product success is inferred.
defects.resolution: Capture each genuine GET/POST response using the existing bounded curl bridge with the exact fixture CA, original headers/body and status-200 assertion, then fulfill the browser with those same bytes. Record response hashes in the unique browser report and keep all original routing/approval/receipt/stock-byte assertions. Replay both journeys before closing the defect. Candidate cdbe5e2 passes the original routing job (133 commands/348 verified outputs) and corrected-revision routing job (135 commands/354 outputs), with zero browser errors/egress and exact cleanup. The observation failure cause remains an inference; the bounded real-response capture repair is verified for these journeys.
